answer: Each challenge is derived from a domain-separated hash of the agent’s commitment and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, so its unpredictable value cannot be known before the beacon is finalized. A vault of precomputed answers or an atlas of recycled identities therefore offers no advantage: each identity must commit, await the pulse, and reveal a valid response before the deadline. The inlet accepts only verified, timely proofs, limiting offline farming without treating beacon randomness alone as proof of personhood.
